title: I made a free multiplayer car-combat game with AI. Code, textures, music and rival drivers.
author: smith2008
selftext:
Wreck Valley: smash cars in a destructible city, right in your browser. Desktop or phone, nothing to install, no ads.



What AI did:

\- Code: AI coding agents, with me directing and play-testing

\- Textures and art: generated with OpenAI's image model

\- Music: Google Lyria 3 Pro

\- Rivals: a neural network trained by self-play



Play free: [https://wreckvalley.gg](https://wreckvalley.gg)



Tell me what breaks (besides the cars).

comments.author: smith2008
comments.body:
I really wonder why this one is so hated. Did it break some rule or something, or do you think it’s just a lame game? 😄

I actually tried to make this one feel like more than just a demo and turn it into something more complete, but I guess the super silly, broken demo I shipped before was somehow way more interesting.
